name: DeepBOM: Bill of Materials
author: workinnovate

sections.description:
DeepBOM: Bill of Materials brings manufacturing-focused inventory management to WooCommerce, without the complexity of enterprise ERP software.

Whether you manufacture products, assemble components, or package product kits, DeepBOM keeps your raw material inventory accurate by automatically tracking component usage whenever orders are completed.

Core Features

  • Create unlimited Bills of Materials (BOM)
  • Build multi-level BOMs with assemblies and sub-assemblies
  • Automatic stock deduction: raw materials are deducted when a WooCommerce order is completed
  • Track raw materials and components separately from finished products
  • Real-time BOM cost calculations
  • Visual BOM tree for understanding product structure at a glance
  • Link raw materials to simple products and to individual variations of variable products
  • Add, edit, update, and delete raw materials directly from the Edit Product screen
  • Search your existing database to add raw materials quickly
  • Quick popup to set the quantity of each raw material needed to make the final product
  • Native WooCommerce integration with no third-party dependencies
  • Lightweight, fast, and easy to configure

Perfect For

  • Manufacturers and assemblers
  • Cosmetics and skincare brands
  • Food and beverage producers
  • Apparel and textile makers
  • Furniture and woodworking shops
  • Electronics assembly
  • Handmade and artisan products
  • Subscription boxes and product kits

How It Works

  1. Add your raw materials and components.
  2. Link them to a product or to a product variation, and set the quantity needed to make one unit.
  3. When a WooCommerce order is marked as Completed, DeepBOM deducts the required quantities from your raw material stock.

DeepBOM Pro

An optional Pro version is available for stores that need more advanced manufacturing tools, such as reusable Recipes, advanced inventory management, enhanced manufacturing workflows, and additional reporting and automation. The free version is fully functional on its own.

Learn more about DeepBOM Pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/deepbom-bill-of-materials/ directory, or install it directly via Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated (required).
  4. Open the DeepBOM menu in your WordPress admin to start creating Bills of Materials.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. DeepBOM is built on top of WooCommerce and requires it to manage products and inventory. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I create multi-level Bills of Materials?

Yes. DeepBOM supports unlimited nesting. You can create BOMs with assemblies, sub-assemblies, and nested components at any depth.

Does the plugin automatically deduct raw material stock?

Yes. When a WooCommerce order status changes to “Completed”, DeepBOM automatically deducts the required quantities from your raw material inventory based on the configured BOM.

Is DeepBOM compatible with variable products?

Yes. You can link raw materials to a variable product or to each individual variation, and view them from the product variation screen.

Can I manage raw materials from the Edit Product screen?

Yes. You can view, add, update, and delete the raw materials linked to a product directly from the Edit Product screen, and search existing items to add them quickly.

Are Recipes included in the free version?

No. Reusable Recipes are part of DeepBOM Pro. The free version supports full BOM creation, multi-level nesting, automatic stock deduction, and cost tracking.

Where can I get support?

Please use the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org. For other inquiries, including questions about DeepBOM Pro, visit workinnovate.com/contact.
